I am too old now to carry heavy bags of chemical fertilizer from the market, and they cost too much money for my small plot. I will spread cow manure that my grandchildren collect from our animals, and I will plant the same maize seed I have kept from last year's harvest because it has always fed my family. The rains will come as God wills, so I do not irrigate, and I will weed with my hands like I have always done. My family will do most of the work, but I may hire a young man for a few days to help with the plowing since my back is not strong anymore.
